frequency_question: How often do nominated executive branch officials receive a floor confirmation vote within the standard legislative timeline?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations to cabinet-level or equivalent major agency posts sent to the Senate; excludes withdrawn nominations prior to committee action if administrative policy dictates withdrawal before scheduling.
coverage_note: 10 named primary cabinet/agency examples evaluated; highly representative of high-profile confirmations.
known_gaps: Minor agency nominations with lower tracking priority are excluded.
skeleton: Major agency nominations reaching the floor stage versus those stalled or withdrawn entirely before a vote.
multiplier: 10 hits out of 10 major cabinet-level tracked cases meeting criteria within window.
validity_reason: Valid for the duration of current legislative procedural norms regarding executive appointments.
